description:
## Why
The internal runtime-transport shape {Omitted | scalar | TupleFields | DirectCallable} is re-encoded in three lockstep enums that differ only in leaf payload:
- RuntimeDemand (Ignore | Value | TupleFields | Callable) -- what's needed
- RuntimeValueLayout (Omitted | Value{ty,repr} | TupleFields | DirectCallable{fn, capture_lanes}) -- the settled plan
- NativeLocalValue (Runtime(Var) | TupleFields | DirectCallable{fn, captures}) -- the realized binding (native.rs only)

Every variant must be mirrored across all three plus the derive/decode/encode maps -- a lockstep tax. The disease surfaced concretely: NativeLocalValue is MISSING the Omitted variant, so decode_runtime_value(Omitted) returns a bare FatalError. enum_count_list (Enum.count over a List) hits this: count's resume continuation captures `enumerable` with an Omitted layout (count_result ignores it), and native lowering cannot decode the Omitted capture.

NativeLocalValue is pure redundancy: a realized value is fully described by its RuntimeValueLayout (the structure) + its flat Var lanes (the data). The TupleFields/Value/DirectCallable structure NativeLocalValue carries already lives in the layout. RuntimeValueLayout::DirectCallable was ALREADY de-over-modeled to flat capture_lanes (see the comment at its def); NativeLocalValue::DirectCallable kept the vestigial recursive Vec, filled only with flat Runtime leaves.

## Decision
RuntimeValueLayout is the single transport shape. Delete NativeLocalValue. Represent a realized value as (RuntimeValueLayout, flat Vec<Var>) -- a pairing, not a new shape. Omitted falls out for free: { layout: Omitted, lanes: [] }.

## Scope (native.rs, ~40 refs, one file)
- Define the realized-value pairing (layout + flat lanes); ValueEnv stores it.
- Rewrite the maps against (layout, lanes):
  - decode_runtime_value(layout, lanes) -> realized; Omitted -> empty lanes (the fix).
  - encode_runtime_value(target_layout, realized) -> emit lanes; Omitted -> none (already handled on encode side).
  - materialize_native_value(realized) -> single Var (Value=lane0; TupleFields=box; DirectCallable=box; Omitted=genuine error).
  - delete flatten_native_value_to_lanes (lanes are already flat).
- Rewrite structural consumers against the layout: TupleField access (slice lanes by field layout), AssertTuple (no-op when layout is TupleFields{n}), DirectCallable build/use.

## Out of scope
RuntimeDemand (its Callable arm is a flat surface, genuinely different -- not a transport tree) and ReturnAbi/ExecutableNeed (legitimate boundary/key facts per outline.md). Leave them.

## Done when
- NativeLocalValue is gone; rg finds no refs.
- enum_count_list_settles_to_int re-enabled and green.
- Full lib suite green, zero warnings.
title: Collapse realized transport onto RuntimeValueLayout: delete NativeLocalValue
